title: •Booster In _Pulsar Skate_

game_text: May add 1 pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Booster, who provides ability of 3. May not be targeted by weapons or Utinni Effects. Once per game, may ▼ Mirax here. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Owned by legendary Terrik family of smugglers. Used to chase down the pirates who killed Wedge’s parents. On Corellian Security’s most wanted list. 37.5 meters long.
